description: %elidable maximal T makes T maximal without maximal in %ambiguity-resolution. On A X B, the one derivation elides T after body → X, but body → X B is longer, so the main parse does not count it. The text is rejected at the forbidden T (engine §2, §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%elidable maximal T
%rule text A body [T] B
%rule body X | X B
